Daily Ritual

Developed for Everyday Comfort

ALFURIN is designed to fit seamlessly into your daily routine. A non-greasy, dermatologically tested formula that leaves skin calm and protected from the very first application — no harsh ingredients, no compromise.

1
Cleanse

Gently clean affected areas with lukewarm water. Pat dry with a soft towel.

2
Apply the Lotion

Pump 2–3 times and massage evenly into skin. Ideal for morning use on large areas.

3
Apply the Cream

Use on thicker plaques or as an overnight treatment for intensive repair.
